findings.body: The constructor now refers to a variable `endpoint` that is never introduced because the function signature was not updated to accept an `endpoint` argument. This results in a compilation failure, breaking the build. Add an `endpoint: impl Into<String>` parameter to `ExternalTtsProvider::new` and adjust the code accordingly.
findings.title: Add missing endpoint parameter to constructor

value.summary: The change introduces a compilation error: the new `endpoint` field is used in `ExternalTtsProvider::new` without adding a corresponding parameter, leaving `endpoint` undefined.
